meta.name: game-playtest
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants to plan, execute, or analyze a structured playtest session with behavioral observation. Covers protocol design, observer guides, and data synthesis. Triggers on: "playtest", "player feedback", "usability test", "observation session", "playtest analysis". Do NOT invoke for QA bug testing (use game-qa-lead) or balance tuning (use game-balance-check). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并分析游戏玩法测试会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要组织游戏玩法测试并收集玩家行为数据。
copy.tagline_en: Plan and analyze structured playtest sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to organize playtests and collect player behavior data.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计、执行和分析游戏试玩测试，重点观察玩家行为而非听他们说什么。它会生成观察表、记录玩家动作/犹豫/困惑/情绪，并产出测试报告。
howto.when: 当你想规划或分析一次有结构的游戏试玩测试，涉及行为观察时触发。例如你说“playtest”、“玩家反馈”、“可用性测试”等关键词。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新手关卡的试玩测试方案。
say.note: Claude 会生成测试目标、观察表和流程。

say.text: 分析这次试玩中玩家在第一个Boss战的行为数据。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供观察记录，然后分析模式。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you plan, run, and analyze structured playtest sessions with behavioral observation. It generates observer guides, tracks player actions/hesitations/confusions/emotions, and produces a report with findings and recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to plan or analyze a structured playtest with behavioral observation. Keywords include "playtest", "player feedback", "usability test", etc.

say_en.text: Design a playtest plan for the first level.
say_en.note: Claude will generate objectives, observation sheet, and procedure.

say_en.text: Analyze the behavioral data from the boss fight session.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for observations and identify patterns.
